Verdict: PASS

- [P3] `aragora/swarm/quorum_evidence.py:1978` (`_record_review_adjudication_if_applicable`) — the guard catches only `(AttributeError, ImportError, RuntimeError, TypeError, ValueError)`. For a feature whose entire contract is "observe-only, must never affect the gate," any unlisted exception escaping `adjudicate()`/`has_blocking_finding_or_label()` (e.g. `re.error`, `KeyError` on a pathological reviewer body) would propagate and crash the settlement hot path. Consider `except Exception` with a `# noqa: BLE001` here — the log line ("omitting adjudication") already implies swallow-all intent. Low risk since the module fails closed internally, but broadening would fully honor the shadow-feature guarantee.
